title: Taking Out the Chef Droid
description: The floor grate in the kitchen moved and the Droids were alerted to what they believed to be rats. When EV-9D9 investigated, Boba Fett springs from the opening, and smashes the multi-purpose Droid. His vegetable-chopping companion turned his attention to Fett, swinging a plethora of knives, and advanced closer to attack. However, before any attack could be carried out, Fennec Shand snuck in behind him and sliced off his head.
